what_happened: Research found a third site carrying the convention gap beyond the two the task description names: FormalSystem/Metalogic/Decidability/RaySummary/README.md line 781 says 'both readings of period 1 under the unrecorded P versus P + 1 convention'. Landing the record in LadderModel.lean and the extension note without touching that line would leave the library README asserting the convention is unrecorded. The probe docstring (specs/evidence/seam-gluing-ray-product/ladder-residue-index-refutation.lean, section 'The P versus P + 1 convention') carries the same 'no record fixes whether' sentence.

The task description grounds the modulus-3 refutation on 'the existing parity observable'. No compiled theorem states that: cell_succ_ne is at countdown offset 1 only, and gate_parity_separates is a positive gate requiring 1 <= P. Modulus 3 IS covered by the compiled object_only_parameters_refuted (every (T,P,B)). The record must cite that theorem for the uniform claim and mark the parity degeneracy as a mechanism-level observation, since no new theorems are to be added.

lean_run_code settled the Qp fixture's reach-set period in one call with a core-Lean List model of reachStep (no Mathlib import, no project build): minimal period 2 from threshold 2 starting from the pending singleton, and constant from Finset.univ. That start-set dependence is itself a finding and cost one tool call.

Research report itemized the 'modulus must dominate' -> 'must be a multiple of' sharpening for the source-store note only. A planning-time grep found the same claim at 11 further occurrences across 6 files (LadderModel.lean:81; RaySummary/README.md:45,460,784; docs/theorem-index.md:214-217; scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh:1013; the probe docstring:104), plus specs/ROADMAP.md:20. docs/theorem-index.md declares itself authoritative over README.md, so a one-site fix would leave the declared-authoritative ledger carrying the weaker claim. Plan folds the sharpening into each file-owning phase and adds a residual-occurrence grep to the final gate phase.

Every load-bearing fact in the research report verified exactly at plan time: note is 180 lines matching index-entries.json line_count 180; the 'unrecorded' clause sits at note:93-95 and RaySummary/README.md:781/784; LadderModel.lean is 219 lines matching the hand-maintained README row; root README.md:19 is the only machine-owned block aggregating FormalSystem totals and RaySummary/README.md carries no BEGIN GENERATED markers. No re-research needed.

Phase 1 docstring insertion pushed a pre-existing continuation line over Lean's 100-char style limit; the scoped build exited 0 but emitted a linter.style.longLine warning. Rewrapped three trailing docstring lines and rebuilt clean.

Phase 1 commit was blocked by the pre-commit typst-sync-check.sh --counts-only gate: the +12-line docstring growth moved formalsystem-line-count in the generated typst/generated/status.typ (353796 -> 353808). The plan anticipated this class of collision only for README.md's inventory block (Phase 6), not for this second generated surface. Resolved with 'bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix' and staging that file with the phase commit.
